paragraphs: Xerox is a workplace technology company, building and integrating services-led, software-enabled, workplace solutions for enterprises large and small. As customers seek to manage information and document workflows across digital and physical platforms, we deliver a seamless, secure, and sustainable experience. Whether inventing the copier, the Ethernet, the laser printer or more, Xerox has long defined the modern work experience and continues to do so with investments in IT infrastructure, artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), intelligent document processing (IDP), robotic process automation (RPA) and other technologies that enable Xerox to deliver essential products and services to address the productivity challenges of a hybrid workplace and distributed workforce.

Xerox serves customers globally in North America, Europe, Latin America, Brazil, Asia Pacific (APAC), the Middle East, Africa, and India. This geographic span allows us to deliver our technology and solutions to customers of all sizes, regardless of complexity or number of customer locations.

2025 was a pivotal year for Reinvention, which is a multi-year strategy designed to transform the way Xerox operates. Its objectives are to strengthen our core business and improve financial flexibility enabling investments in solutions, initiatives, and capabilities intended to support market share gains and expansion into higher-growth verticals beyond print, with the goal of delivering sustainable long-term revenue and profit growth.

In 2025, we completed the acquisition of Lexmark International II, LLC (Lexmark) (the Lexmark Acquisition). The addition of Lexmark is intended to enhance Xerox's operational resilience and cost structure. Expected benefits include increased presence in the A4 color segment, entry into the APAC print market, potential reductions in product and tariff-related costs through the use of Lexmark's manufacturing footprint, improved supply chain flexibility, and the ability to leverage Lexmark's global capability centers and IT infrastructure to support customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. The combined company also offers a wider portfolio of offerings and services to Lexmark's large customer base. During the year we also completed the integration of ITsavvy, forming our new Xerox IT Solutions organization (IT Solutions). IT Solutions meaningfully expands Xerox's reach of the typical IT budget by providing additional offerings as well as opportunities that strengthen our relationship with existing clients. In 2025, growth of the IT Solutions business was driven primarily by ITsavvy as well as client demand for integrated infrastructure, cloud, security, and automation solutions.
Our Reinvention efforts are focused on Operational Simplification, and Commercial Optimization and Growth. During 2025, we made significant progress across each priority.
–Achieved cumulative run-rate gross cost savings of more than $500 million through year-end 2025, including Integration savings
–Eliminated duplicative systems, implemented more efficient systems and processes, and enhanced efficiency in procurement, warehousing, inventory management and demand planning
–Launched tools focused on digital transformation
–Re-entered the growing mid-volume Production inkjet market through partnerships, with the launch of IJP900 and Proficio products
–Launched Inside Sales operations in U.S. and Canada –Invested in partner programs and customer initiatives
–Integrated ITsavvy, enhancing Xerox's IT Solutions offering and expanding Total Addressable Market (TAM) of Xerox's offerings
–Closed the Lexmark Acquisition, providing greater exposure to growing Print markets

In 2026, the focus of Reinvention will progress to specific initiatives designed to i) further optimize our commercial operations, ii) leverage the capabilities of our acquired business to accelerate Reinvention, and iii) simplify the business. We will continue to leverage the Global Business Services (GBS) organization to design and implement continuous operating efficiencies.

During the year, the Company extended its forward flow program to Europe to support liquidity and balance sheet management. During 2025, the Company entered into a funding arrangement in the United Kingdom and France with an affiliate of LCM Capital LLP, as well as an arrangement with an additional partner in Portugal. These transactions provide for the sale of certain finance receivables, with the Company continuing to service the receivables under separate servicing agreements.

Our business, results of operations, cash flow, and financial condition are affected by global macroeconomic conditions.
If we fail to successfully develop new products, technologies, and service offerings, we may be unable to retain current customers and gain new customers.
Our business and financial performance could suffer if we do not manage the risks associated with our services businesses properly.
Our profitability is dependent upon our ability to obtain adequate pricing for our products and services and to improve our cost structure.
We have outsourced a material portion of our manufacturing operations and significantly rely on third-party manufacturers, subcontractors, and suppliers.
We may be unable to attract and retain key personnel while our business model undergoes significant changes.
We may not achieve the expected benefits of Reinvention, which may adversely affect our business.

Our government contracts are subject to termination rights, audits, and investigations, which, if exercised, could negatively impact our reputation and reduce our ability to compete for new contracts.
Our ability to fund our customer financing activities at economically competitive levels depends on our ability to source capital and the cost of capital in the credit markets.
Our level of debt could adversely affect our financial condition and reduce our financial and operational flexibility.
Our products and services may be affected by design and manufacturing defects that could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Our financial condition and results of operations could be adversely affected by employee benefit-related funding requirements.
Our intellectual property rights are valuable, and any inability to protect them could reduce the value of our products, services, and brand.
Failure to meet evolving corporate social responsibility expectations, standards, or goals could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, or stock price.

The international nature of our business subjects us to a number of risks, including foreign exchange and interest rate risk and unfavorable political, regulatory, and tax conditions in foreign countries.
Tariffs or other restrictions on foreign imports could negatively impact our financial performance.
We operate globally and changes in tax laws could adversely affect our results.
We are subject to breaches of our security systems, cyber-attacks, and service interruptions, which could expose us to liability, litigation, regulatory action and damage our reputation.

paragraphs: Xerox 是一家工作場域科技公司，開發並整合以服務為導向、軟體驅動的工作場域解決方案，服務從大型企業到小型企業。當客戶試圖在數位與實體平台之間管理資訊與文件流程時，我們提供無縫、安全且可持續的體驗。無論是發明複印機、乙太網路、雷射印表機，或是其他技術，Xerox 長久以來定義了現代工作體驗，並持續透過投資資訊科技基礎建設、人工智慧（AI）、物聯網（IoT）、智慧文件處理（IDP）、機器人流程自動化（RPA）及其他技術，來提供必要的產品與服務，以解決混合型工作場域與分散式工作團隊的生產力挑戰。
Xerox 在全球各區域服務客戶，包括北美、歐洲、拉丁美洲、巴西、亞太（APAC）、中東、非洲及印度。這個地理範圍讓我們能夠為不同規模的客戶提供技術與解決方案，不論其複雜度或客戶據點數量。
2025 年是 Reinvention（轉型）的關鍵年，這是一個多年度策略，旨在改變 Xerox 的運作方式。其目標是強化我們的核心業務，並提升財務彈性，以支持投資解決方案、計畫與能力，用以支持市佔率成長與擴張至印刷以外的高成長垂直領域，目標是實現可持續的長期營收與獲利成長。

在 2025 年，我們完成了對 Lexmark International II, LLC（Lexmark）（Lexmark 收購）的收購。Lexmark 的加入旨在增強 Xerox 的運營韌性與成本結構。預期的效益包括在 A4 色彩段的市場佔有率提升、進入 APAC 印刷市場、透過 Lexmark 的製造據點使用，潛在降低產品與關稅相關成本、改善供應鏈靈活性，以及利用 Lexmark 的全球能力中心與資訊科技基礎建設，以支持客戶滿意度與運營效率。合併後的公司也為 Lexmark 的大型客戶羣提供更廣的產品與服務組合。在本年度，我們也完成了對 ITsavvy 的整合，成立新的 Xerox IT 解決方案組織（IT 解決方案）。IT 解決方案擴大了 Xerox 通常資訊科技預算的覆蓋範圍，透過提供額外的產品與機會，強化與現有客戶的關係。在 2025 年，IT 解決方案業務的成長主要由 ITsavvy 以及客戶對整合基礎建設、雲端、安全與自動化解決方案的需求所驅動。
我們的轉型努力聚焦於運營簡化與商業優化與成長。在 2025 年，我們在每個優先事項上都取得了顯著進展。
– 截至 2025 年年底，已實現累計運營成本節省超過 500 百萬美元，包括整合節省
– 消除重複系統，實施更高效的系統與流程，並提升採購、倉儲、存貨管理與需求規劃的效率
– 發布專注於數位轉型的工具
–重新進入成長中的中等規模生產噴墨市場，透過合作夥伴關係，推出 IJP900 與 Proficio 產品
–在美國和加拿大啟動內勤銷售業務 – 投資於合作夥伴計畫與客戶方案
–整合資訊科技專業能力，提升 Xerox 的資訊科技解決方案，並擴大 Xerox 產品的總可達市場 (TAM)
–完成 Lexmark 收購，提供更廣的成長列印市場曝光度
2026 年，革新計畫的重點將進展至特定的倡議，以 i) 進一步優化商業運作，ii) 藉助收購業務的能力加速革新，以及 iii) 簡化業務。我們將持續利用全球業務服務 (GBS) 組織設計並實施持續運作效率。
本年度，本公司將其前向流動計畫延伸至歐洲，以支援流動性與資產負債表管理。2025 年，本公司與 LCM Capital LLP 的附屬公司簽訂資金安排，並與葡萄牙的另一合作夥伴簽訂協議。這些交易允許銷售特定的金融應收款，本公司持續透過獨立的服務協議服務這些應收款。

paragraphs: 2025 年是 Reinvention 的關鍵一年，Reinvention 是一個多年度策略，旨在改變 Xerox 的運作方式。其目標為強化我們的核心業務，並提升財務彈性，以支應對解決方案、計畫與能力的投資，使 Xerox 能在現有市場中取得市佔率，並轉向印刷以外的高成長垂直領域，實現長期、可持續的營收與獲利成長。2025 年全年總營收為 7.0 十億美元，成長 12.9%，反映 Lexmark 收購與 ITsavvy 收購分別帶來 15.5 個百分點與 6.5 個百分點的效益，以及貨幣因素帶來 0.7 個百分點的效益。以 pro forma1 為基礎的總營收則下降 7.6%。

headings: 與我們收購 Lexmark 相關的風險
與本公司普通股及認股權證持有相關的風險
本公司營運、營業成果、現金流及財務狀況受全球總體經濟情勢影響。
若我們未能成功開發新產品、技術及服務方案，可能無法保留現有客戶並獲得新客戶。
本公司營運及財務表現若無法妥善管理相關服務業務相關風險，將可能受影響。
本公司獲利能力取決於本公司能否取得產品與服務的合理價格，並改善成本結構。
本公司已將大量製造作業委外，並嚴重依賴第三方製造商、 subcontractors 及供應商。
本公司可能無法吸引並留住關鍵人才，而本公司商業模式正經歷重大變革。
本公司可能無法實現 Reinvention 的預期效益，這可能對本公司業務產生負面影響。
本公司政府契約受終止權、審計及調查影響，若這些權利被行使，將可能影響本公司聲譽，並降低本公司爭取新契約的能力。
本公司能否以經濟上具有競爭力的水平資助客戶融資活動，取決於本公司能否取得資金來源及信用市場的資金成本。
本公司負債水準可能對財務狀況產生負面影響，並降低財務及運營彈性。
本公司產品及服務可能受設計及製造缺陷影響，此等影響可能重大且不利於本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果。
本公司財務狀況及營運成果可能因員工福利相關資金需求而受到不利影響。
本公司智慧財產權具有價值，若無法有效保護，可能降低本公司產品、服務及品牌的價值。
未能符合日漸嚴格的企業社會責任期待、標準或目標，可能對本公司業務、營運成果、財務狀況或股票價格造成不利影響。
本公司業務具有國際性，因此面臨多種風險，包括外匯及利率風險，以及在海外國家不利的政治、法規及稅務環境。
關稅或其他對進口商品的限制措施，可能對本公司財務表現造成負面影響。
本公司在全球營運，稅法變動可能對本公司營運成果造成不利影響。
本公司可能面臨安全系統遭入侵、網路攻擊及服務中斷等風險，此等風險可能使本公司面臨法律責任、訴訟、法規處分，並損害本公司聲譽。
